name: ordinary-day
about: Two campaigns with leads, a month's spend and two mature cohorts beside a young one.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, both campaigns delivered 7 leads across 14,600 impressions at a combined cost per lead of $40.61.
points: Total spend for the day was $284.25 across 203 clicks and a click rate of 1.4%, with Regional Class A — Joliet driving 6 of the 7 leads at $30.75 per lead, while Dedicated night runs produced 1 lead at $99.75 per lead.
Regional Class A — Joliet spent $184.50 across 9,120 impressions and 141 clicks at a 1.5% click rate, making it the stronger performer on cost per lead today.
Dedicated night runs spent $99.75 across 5,480 impressions and 62 clicks at a 1.1% click rate; with only 1 lead, its cost per lead was $99.75.
Month-to-date spend on Meta for 2026-11 stands at $612.30 with 28 days left in the month.

The mature 2026-09-21 cohort shows 38 leads, with 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 converted (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost after conversion (21.1%); the 2026-09-28 cohort shows 40 leads, with 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 converted (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost after conversion (22.5%).

The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads with 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — it is too young to judge, and its leads are still moving. Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
